verdict.rationale: Godot's first-party docs cover the whole story. Editor plugins can be written entirely in GDScript without reloading the editor, and EditorScript `_run()` scripts add custom in-editor functionality. Import plugins treat custom assets as first-class resources, and EditorInterface exposes saving and reloading scenes plus inspecting and editing resources programmatically. A runtime probe also confirms headless scripted editor automation, and the Asset Library has a Tools category for distributing such plugins. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of building editor plugins and tools (the community evidence never addresses editor extensibility).
